verifications.claim: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) notes that several small asteroids, including 2026 FM3 (car-sized), are making close flybys of Earth in late March 2026, posing no risk.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'car-sized asteroid ... 2026 FM3 ... late tonight (March 24) ... no such close approaches ... next 100 years'; R3: 'NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) ... car-sized asteroid ... 2026 FM3 ... tomorrow [March 25]' and lists several others; R6: 'car-sized asteroid ... 2026 FM3 ... no threat'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references attribute to NASA/JPL tracking of 2026 FM3 (car-sized) and others in late March 2026 with no risk.

verifications.claim: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and Space state that 2026 FM3 is a ~15-foot car-sized asteroid.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 (Space.com): 'car-sized asteroid ... 2026 FM3'; R3: 'NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) ... car-sized ... about 15 feet across ... 2026 FM3'; R6: 'car-sized ... 13 to 26 ft in diameter ... 2026 FM3'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly from JPL gives 15 feet car-sized; R1 (Space) calls it car-sized; R6 supports size range.

verifications.claim: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and Space state that 2026 FM3 passed within 148,000 miles of Earth on March 24–25, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '147,836 miles ... 10:07 p.m. EDT on March 24 (0207 GMT on March 25)'; R3: '148,000 miles ... March 25'; R6: '147,836 miles ... 10:07 p.m. EDT on March 24'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm ~148,000 miles distance for 2026 FM3 on March 24-25 from NASA/JPL/Space.

verifications.claim: 148,000 miles is roughly 62% of the distance to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '147,836 miles ... only 61.9% of the distance to the moon'; R6: '147,836 miles ... roughly 62% of the distance to the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements confirm the percentage for the distance.
